name: Dog Age Calculator — Breed Specific
description: Estimate a dog's human-equivalent age using its actual age and approximate breed-size category.
search_intent: Convert dog age to human-equivalent age with an adjustment for small, medium, large and giant breeds.

inputs.label: Breed size
inputs.help: Small, medium, large or giant breed-size category.

calculation: Use a transparent breed-size lookup/interpolation model rather than the outdated simple 7× rule. Define age-to-human-equivalent mappings for small, medium, large and giant dogs, interpolate between whole-year values where necessary, and classify approximate life stage. Keep the model clearly described as an estimate rather than a veterinary diagnostic calculation.
limitations: Breed, genetics, weight, health and lifestyle can materially affect aging.
Human-equivalent age is an approximation and should not be used for veterinary diagnosis.
Mixed breeds may not fit one size category precisely.
